description: This file implements whitespace handling rules and utilities for a Git-related project, including parsing whitespace configurations, checking whitespace in lines, fixing whitespace issues, and generating error messages related to whitespace in files.

methods.name: unsigned parse_whitespace_rule(const char * string)
methods.description: Parses a whitespace rule string into internal rule bits.

methods.name: unsigned whitespace_rule(struct index_state * istate,const char * pathname)
methods.description: Retrieves the whitespace rule for a specific file and path, considering attributes.

methods.name: char * whitespace_error_string(unsigned ws)
methods.description: Generates a human-readable string describing whitespace errors based on rule bits.

methods.name: unsigned ws_check_emit_1(const char * line,int len,unsigned ws_rule,FILE * stream,const char * set,const char * reset,const char * ws)
methods.description: Checks a line for whitespace issues according to rules, optionally emitting detailed output.

methods.name: void ws_check_emit(const char * line,int len,unsigned ws_rule,FILE * stream,const char * set,const char * reset,const char * ws)
methods.description: Wrapper around ws_check_emit_1 for checking line and optionally emitting.

methods.name: unsigned ws_check(const char * line,int len,unsigned ws_rule)
methods.description: Checks a line for whitespace issues, returning the rule bits of problems found.

methods.name: int ws_blank_line(const char * line,int len)
methods.description: Determines if a line is blank or contains only whitespace.

methods.name: void ws_fix_copy(struct strbuf * dst,const char * src,int len,unsigned ws_rule,int * error_count)
methods.description: Copies a line to a buffer while fixing whitespace according to rules, possibly correcting indentation and trailing spaces.

ctags.name: ws_check
ctags.pattern: /^unsigned ws_check(const char *line, int len, unsigned ws_rule)$/
